name: Type: Bug
description: Incorrect behaviour, broken functionality, or a regression.

name: Type: Feature
description: A new capability or an improvement to an existing one.

name: Type: Maintenance
description: Dependencies, CI, releases, refactoring, or repository upkeep.

name: Type: Question
description: How the extension works or how to use it.

name: Status: Confirmed
description: Reproduced defect or accepted request; not a delivery commitment.

name: Status: Needs Information
description: Waiting for details, answers, or validation results.

name: Status: Needs Owner Testing
description: Waiting for a check on a real desktop by the owner.

name: Status: Blocked
description: Accepted work waiting on an identified external dependency.

name: Status: Can't Reproduce
description: A documented reproduction attempt did not reproduce the report.

name: Status: Duplicate
description: Already tracked elsewhere; the canonical item is linked.

name: Status: Won't Do
description: Declined as out of scope or unsuitable in its proposed form.
